title: The Pareto front of cost against emissions
caption: Minimising both, C = (5, 5) is dominated by B = (4, 4), which is lower on both axes. A, B and D each beat the others on one objective, so they form the Pareto front.
alt: Four points on a cost against emissions grid; A, B and D joined by a dashed front, and C above and to the right of B.
description: Plot each option as (cost, emissions); lower-left is better.
B = (4, 4) has cost and emissions both at most C's, and strictly less, so C is dominated.
No other pair is ordered on both objectives.
The Pareto optimal set is {A, B, D}.

checks.name: three of the four options are Pareto optimal
C is 1 worse than B in cost and 1 worse in emissions (5 − 4)

fromLesson: Pareto optimal: A, B and D
